fusions.name: Held at Full Draw
fusions.desc: Holds the string at full draw for 2 seconds, then looses an arrow that deals 40 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Loophole Shot
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow through a gap in your shell at an enemy up to 8 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. The target moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Planted Pavise
fusions.desc: Stands a plate of your shell 4 tiles long in front of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Loaded Silence
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.
